'''Neimoidian space'''<ref name="Neimoidians Double Conscription Rate" /> was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="SoN">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref> of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region.<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and their [[Purse world/Legends|purse worlds]] of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], [[Deko Neimoidia/Legends|Deko Neimoidia]], and [[Koru Neimoidia/Legends|Koru Neimoidia]].<ref name="Neimoidians Double Conscription Rate" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it initially declared itself neutral before aligning itself with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], Republic forces were cleaning up the remaining Separatist resistance within Neimoidian space.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
